_about: Public-domain Richard Salter Storrs (1821-1900), Congregational pastor of the Church of the Pilgrims, Brooklyn, for the Word Hoard: The Obligation of Man to Obey the Civil Law (1850), The Constitution of the Human Soul (1857), Conditions of Success in Preaching without Notes (1875), The Early American Spirit (1878), John Wycliffe and the First English Bible (1880), The Recognition of the Supernatural (1881), The Divine Origin of Christianity (1884), The Puritan Spirit (1890) and Bernard of Clairvaux (1892), from Internet Archive scans. His father Richard Salter Storrs (1787-1873) of Braintree is another man. Added 2026-10-23 by lane A, round 56 (my pick); Adam may veto the whole shelf. Every printing dated before 1930, so public domain in the US. No uids minted.
